Certainly! The key points or bullet points presented on the slide are:
1. Do not use the first or second person (I, my, we, us)
2. Do not use contractions (can't, won't, doesn't)
3. Do not use metaphors or figures of speech
4. Avoid saying 'The essay will discuss...' or 'In my opinion...'
5. Avoid using a lot. If you do use it, take care not to repeat it often.
6. Avoid redundancy and repetition.
7. Be specific. Do not use vague words such as 'things' or 'many examples'.
8. Always follow MLA format
9. Use size 12 pt font, Times New Roman, and standard 1" margins
10. Edit, edit, edit!
11. Save your rough work.
12. When writing about literature, always write in the present tense.
13. The Hamlet is a novel of Shakespeare and not 'The Hamlet was a novel of Shakespeare'.
14. Essays should be submitted with one staple in the top left hand corner. Do not put them in folders.
